note_zh: **没有任何检查能看见「一行字压在另一行字上」，此前只能靠人打开图看。** 本包有 107 张图面、两种语言，而英文版的版式是按中文定好后再替换字符串的——没人打开的那一版，正是会压字的那一版（E167）。此处给每一个 `<text>` 按它自己的字号、锚点与 `overflow_qa` 所用的同一个宽度估计器算出外框，只在两框**共处同一行**时判定重叠。
note_en: Nothing could see one label drawn on top of another; the only remedy was a person opening the sheet. There are 107 sheets in two languages, and the English layout is the Chinese one with the strings replaced - the edition nobody opens is the one that collides (E167). Every <text> gets a box from its own size, anchor and the advance estimator overflow_qa gates on, and a pair counts only when the two boxes share a line.
